name: run_diagnostic_step
description: Run one diagnostic step directly against the backend -- no session, no start call needed. Call get_diagnostics_prompt first to see the available steps and how to reason about them. Call one at a time, never several in the same turn -- these steps aren't independent reads, they drive real hub/PLM hardware.

step.description: The exact step name from get_diagnostics_prompt's step catalog (e.g. "quick_plm_sanity_check", "get_full_system_config", "compare_device_links", "services_ops"). Prefer the higher-level steps -- they already combine and interpret the underlying data. Never invented.

params.description: Parameters the step needs, e.g. {"device_id": "..."} for compare_device_links/get_dev_links_table/get_iox_links_table/get_device_family, {"op": "restart", "service": "..."} for services_ops. Omit or leave empty for steps that need nothing, like quick_plm_sanity_check, get_full_system_config, or get_all_plm_links.
